            depth_multiplier=1,
            activation='relu'
        )

            kernel_size=(5, 5),
            strides=(1, 1),
            padding='same',
            depth_multiplier=1,
            activation='relu'
        )
        self.bn_5x5 = tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization(axis=-1)
        
        # Block 2: Feature Extraction Branches
        self.branch_1 = tf.keras.Sequential([

        # Classification
        x = self.flatten(x)
